name: ENERGY-69: causal fourth-order parity block admission against fitted conventional controls
prior_evidence: ENERGY-67 SCREEN_NO_GO; ENERGY-68 exact analytic feasibility only
method: Joint four-feature block admission: OMP-like 5-feature path from first 48 new-world observed intervention effects, ridge alpha 0.3; candidate chooses k=4 only when 16 independent validation outcomes improve MSE by more than 0.01 absolute against k=0, otherwise k=0. The matched cv_path chooses validation-minimum k=0..5 from identical candidate path/fits and uses 64 observed outcomes for final ridge refit. No planted feature supports accessible in learner.
source_language: Python 3.13 NumPy 2.3.5 scikit-learn 1.8.0; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1

pre_freeze_excluded_smoke.used_for: implementation compatibility and sanity only, not inference
pre_freeze_excluded_smoke.decision: exclude all scores; no source modification after this smoke

world_definition: Nine intervenable independent ±1 inputs; 126 supplied quadruple Walsh features; random hidden distinct source supports 0,2,4 or 4 plus 1 fifth-order OUT-OF-GRAMMAR; coefficient magnitude 0.55 (fourth), 0.45 (fifth), Gaussian observation noise σ=0.30. SeedSequence([screen_seed, family_index, world_id, 69]) with NumPy PCG64. One randomized permutation of 512 assignments per world: train first48, validation next16, cold held next48 disjoint. Fresh generator for each world. Same 64 witnessed intervention outcomes given to each fit.
controls: cv_path (exact same selected OMP path/fits, validation-select k=0..5)
fully fit ElasticNet l1=.8 alpha {0.01,0.05,0.2} validation chosen, max_iter=3000
shuffled-label greedy negative (same 48 train, no hold leakage)
metrics: mean cold held MSE across 72 independent cases
fit+inference wall-clock seconds per arm on one core (descriptive only, feature-generation common cost assigned to each arm)
candidate/cv selected k, greedy path digest

gate_rules.strongest_5pct: block4 mean cold MSE <= 0.95 * minimum across cv_path,fixed4,ridge126,elasticnet
gate_rules.every_seed_strongest: block4 mean cold MSE strictly lower than each of four controls on EACH of 3 independent seeds
gate_rules.family_non_degradation_10pct: block4 mean cold MSE <= 1.10 * strongest conventional control within EVERY family (including fifth-order OOG)
gate_rules.null_guard_10pct: block4 no-signal/null cold MSE <= 1.10 * cv_path no-signal/null cold MSE
gate_rules.shuffled_negative_20pct: block4 overall cold MSE <= 0.80 * shuffled negative overall cold MSE

classification: DEVELOPMENT_GO_ONLY if all five gates true, otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; a GO is never SCIENTIFIC_PASS; no reserved ENERGY-67 primary; no retune/retry on these seeds
limitations: Cold means unseen intervention identities in same law, NOT cross-world or unknown-grammar transfer
No native Yggdrasil, architecture integration, learning loop, first-use, or scientific acceptance
Validation selection not compute-equivalent to ElasticNet; no physical energy or guaranteed speed superiority
isolation: no changed Yggdrasil code/weights or accepted main
no scheduler, owner, runner, external API, merge, deployment
